quotes.summary_phrase: Duncan Robinson on the Pistons' identity and winning despite poor shooting
quotes.excerpt: we can win games in different ways. They're not all going to be ugly, but that's what's required.
quotes.quote: That's more to our identity. We can win games in different ways. They're not all going to be ugly, but that's what's required. That's what we'll do. We didn't make a lot of shots tonight as a group, but I thought we took the right ones for the most part. We stayed process-driven on it, but we got a lot of stops. Of course, a lot of turnovers, which is great for us.

quotes.summary_phrase: Duncan Robinson on the team's reaction to Ron's performance
quotes.excerpt: I think you saw just the reaction from the group on the bench, how much we all love seeing it.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: What was it like for you guys just to see the performance that Ron had today, especially knowing how hard he works on his game, especially on offensive end and his shots?

text_blocks.speaker: Duncan Robinson
text_blocks.text: It was awesome. I think you saw just the reaction from the group on the bench, how much we all love seeing it. He deserves it, he earns it. Sometimes in this league, you can do all the right things and it doesn't necessarily mean that it's going to come together, but it's going to come together. He's had some really positive stretches that we've seen, and it came to fruition today. We expect a lot more of that. We all know the player that he is, what he's capable of, and when he plays with confidence, he's a different player.

quotes.social_post: Duncan Robinson on Ron's breakout performance: He deserves it, he earns it. We all know the player that he is, what he is capable of, and when he plays with confidence, he is a different player.

structured.context: Duncan Robinson reacts to a question about Ron Holland's strong performance and his hard work during the post-game press conference.

quotes.summary_phrase: Duncan Robinson on the team's offensive growth and aggressiveness
quotes.excerpt: I think it's starting to slow down for him, for sure. I think anytime you start the season, there's all these narratives.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: We saw AT was everywhere on both ends, especially in the first half. Just how have you seen him kind of grow into his game and understand how much work that meant to keep you guys on offense with his being aggressive?

text_blocks.speaker: Duncan Robinson
text_blocks.text: I think it's starting to slow down for him, for sure. I think anytime you start the season, there's all these narratives and expectations and what not. Just getting the opportunity to try to settle, a couple games in, we start to get back to our identity as a group. And then for him, I mean, he's so versatile, he's so dynamic. He's just fun to play with. The rim pressure that he's able to provide is really unique. For us, it's really on us to allow him and unlock the best version of himself. Obviously, he's going to will it himself, but it's a group and collective effort.
